_note: Our own tables for procedural NPCs (src/story/npc_gen.gd). Names come from COMP/CON's lists (data/compcon/generators). Each NPC gets one entry from each table; 'personality' picks the line pools a scene uses (e.g. greet_company_rep_gruff falls back to greet_company_rep). 'archetypes' = the part an NPC plays in a hub's story (patterns: docs/research/lancer_campaigns.md); each comes with secrets a pilot can uncover with a Read a Situation check.

talks with their hands, constantly
has a prosthetic arm painted in old unit colors
never quite meets your eyes
hums old colony work songs

speaks very softly, so you have to lean in

wants.text: someone to deal with the raiders on the ridge road
news of a sibling who went missing out past the perimeter
payback against the people who burned their workshop
an escort for a convoy heading out next week
help holding the pumping station until reinforcements arrive
proof that the local administrator is selling them out

archetypes.name: the idealist
secrets: They've been passing information to the other side, because they think it will end the fighting sooner.
They took this posting to find out what happened to their old unit.

archetypes.name: the compromised official
secrets: Someone has leverage on them, and they hate every order they pass on.
They're skimming from the relief shipments to pay off a debt.

archetypes.name: the survivor
secrets: They were there the night the old settlement burned, and they know who lit it.
They're planning to leave, and they're taking the kids with them.

archetypes.name: the climber
secrets: They're reporting everything the squad does to their superiors, for a promotion.
They've already promised your next job to someone else.

archetypes.name: the true believer
secrets: They're quietly recruiting for a cause the locals would never accept.
They'd die for their faction, and they expect you to as well.

archetypes.name: the one with a code
secrets: They never sell to raiders, and they'll cut off anyone who does.
They're protecting someone the authorities are hunting.

archetypes.name: the old soldier
secrets: They used to fly a mech, and they still dream about the last drop.
They deserted, years ago. Nobody here knows.

archetypes.name: the one who listens
secrets: They talk to an NHP every night, and they think it's lonely.
They've seen what a cascading NHP does, and they're afraid it's starting again.
